indication.text: Treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic liver disease who are scheduled to undergo a procedure

citations.quote: DOPELET (avatrombopag) is indicated for the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic liver disease who are scheduled to undergo a procedure.

target_moa.text: Orally administered second-generation thrombopoietin (TPO) receptor (c-MPL) agonist that promotes megakaryocyte production, maturation, and platelet formation

citations.quote: Avatrombopag maleate (E5501, DOPTELET®), hereafter avatrombopag, is an orally administered second generation thrombopoietin (TPO) receptor (c-MPL) agonist that promotes megakaryocyte production, maturation, and the formation of platelets.
It is an orally dosed tablet with a dosing strength at 20 mg.
Mechanism of Action	Avatrombopag (molecular weight of 650 g/mol):Is a thrombopoietin receptor (c-Mpl) agonist.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥3%) are pyrexia (10%), abdominal pain (7%), nausea, headache, fatigue (4%), and peripheral edema (3%). Treatment-emergent thromboembolic events were reported in 0.4% (1/274) of avatrombopag-treated patients vs 1.3% (2/156) of placebo patients.
